en: Full of fishes and alligators and full of raging whirlpools. O king, Hara (Shiva) (instantly) held her (on his head) who was like a girdle to the sky and falling on his forehead she looked like a garland of pearls.

sa: चित्तस्य हि प्रसादेन हन्ति कर्म शुभाशुभम्। प्रसन्नात्माऽऽत्मनि स्थित्वा सुखमानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
en: A pure-minded man, by purifying his heart, is able to destroy the good and evil effects of his actions and obtains eternal bliss by the enlightenment of his inner spirit.

sa: देवाश्च ऋषयश्चैव वसन्त्यद्यापि भारत। तेषां सायं तथा प्रातर्दृश्यते हव्यवाहनः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the celestials and the Rishis still live here and both in the morning and the evening their carrying of libations (Agni) is to be seen here.

sa: ततः सर्वे महाराज सगणा: सहवाहनाः। विदर्भानभिजग्मुस्ते यतः सर्वे महीक्षितः॥
en: O great king, mounted on their vehicles, accompanied by their attendants, they all betook themselves to the country of the Vidharbhas where all the rulers of the earth had gone.

sa: यजन्ते वेदविदुषो मां देवयजने स्थितम्। पृथिव्यां क्षत्रियेन्द्राश्च पार्थिवाः स्वर्गकाक्षिणः॥
en: I am ever present in the sacrifices of the celestials; those that know the Vedas offer sacrifices to On earth those chief Kshatriyas, those kings who desire to obtain heaven.

sa: कथं समृद्धो गत्वाहं तव हर्षविवर्धनः। परिच्युतो गमिष्यामि तव शोकविवर्धनः॥
en: There was a time when repairing there in all my prosperity, I enhanced your delight. Shorn of it (prosperity) how can I now repair there to add to your sorrow?

sa: तुम्बुरुस्तु प्रमुदितो गन्धर्वो वाजिनां शतम्। आम्रपत्रसवर्णानामददाद्धेममालिनाम्॥
en: The Gandharva Tumburu cheerfully gave one hundred horses of the colour of the mango leaf, all adorned with gold (ornaments).

sa: स्नात्वा कुरुवरश्रेष्ठ प्रयतात्मा समाहितः। तर्घ्य देवान् पितॄश्चैव विष्णुलोके महीयते॥
en: O foremost of the Kurus, bathing there with subdued soul and rapt attention and offering oblations to the Pitris and the celestials one is adored in the regions of Vishnu.

sa: आमन्त्र्य यक्षराजं वै ततः पिब हरस्व च। नातोऽन्यथा त्वया शक्यं किंचित् पुष्करमीक्षितुम्।।८।
en: First take the permission of the king of the Yakshas and then drink (the water of this lake) and take away (the lotuses) If you do not act thus, you will not be able even to look at these flowers.

sa: तां कृष्यमाणां च रजस्वलांच स्रस्तोत्तरीयामतदहमाणाम्। वृकोदरः प्रेक्ष्य युधिष्ठिरं च चकार कोयं परमार्तरूपः॥
en: Seeing her who was in her season thus dragged and her upper garments loosened, seeing her in that condition which she did not deserve, Vrikodara (Bhima), afflicted beyond endurance, cast his eyes on Yudhisthira and gave vest to his anger.

sa: कथं तु देवा हविषा गयेन परितर्पिताः। पुनः शक्ष्यन्त्युपादातुमन्यैर्दत्तानि कानिचित्॥
en: The celestials have been so very much fed with the Ghee that Gaya has offered them that they are not able to take anything more offered by any one else.

sa: कुशलेन कृतं कर्म क; साधु स्वनुष्ठितम्। इदं त्वकुशलेनेति विशेषादुपलभ्यते॥
en: If a work is done by a clever work-man it is done well; from the difference in execution another work may be said to be that of an unskilled hand.

sa: वर्तमाने तदा ताभ्यां बाहुयुद्धे सुदारुणे। माद्रीपुत्रावतिक्रुद्धावुभावप्यभ्यधावताम्॥
en: When they were fighting a fearful wrestling match, the sons of Madri (Nakula and Sahadeva), becoming exceedingly angry, rushed forward.

sa: चर्मण्वतीं समासाद्य नियतो नियताशनः। रन्तिदेवाभ्यनुज्ञातमग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्॥
en: Going to Charmanvati with regulated diet and vows, he obtains at the command of Rantideva the fruit of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दः सौभमध्ये व्यवर्धत। वध्यतां विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः पततां च महार्णवे॥
en: Thereupon loud cries of those dying of the wounds inflicted by the arrows rose on the Saubha (car); and they (those wounded) fell into the water of the great ocean.

sa: ते मृगद्विजसंघुष्टं नानादुमलतायुतम्। शाखामृगगणैश्चैव सेवितं सुमनोरमम्॥ पुण्यं पद्मसरोयुक्तं सपल्वलमहावनम्। उपतस्थुर्महाभागा माल्यवन्तं महागिरिम्॥
en: Those highly fortunate ones then reached that sacred and highly beautiful and mighty mountain Malayavana, resounding with the voices of birds and beasts, abounding in many trees and creepers, inhabited by monkeys and containing lotus lakes, marshes and great forests.

sa: यथा दारुमयी योषा नरवीर समाहिता। ईरयत्यङ्गमङ्गानि तथा राजनिमा: प्रजाः॥
en: O hero among men, O king, as a wooden figure is made to move its limbs by the wirepuller so are all these creatures (made to act by the lord.)

sa: ऋजोर्मदोर्वदान्यस्य ह्रीमतः सत्यवादिनः। कथमक्षव्यसनजा बुद्धिरापतिता तव॥
en: How could your mind, siinple, gentle, liberal, modest and truthful as you are, be drawn to the vice of gambling?

sa: देवदानवयक्षाणां सर्पगन्धर्वरक्षसाम्। अवध्योऽहं भवेयं च वर एष वृतो मया।॥
en: "Such a boon is asked by me, as will render me incapable of being killed by either the celestials, the Danavas the Yakshas or by the snakes, Gandharvas or Rakshasas.'

sa: भवता नाभिवाद्योऽहमभिवाद्यो भवान् मया। व्रतमेतादृशं ब्रह्मन् परिष्वज्यो भवान् मया॥
en: O Brahmana, I do not deserve to receive obeisance from you, but I must make obeisance to you. This is the vow observed by me, namely you must embrace me.

sa: ततो नादृश्यत तदा सौभं कुरुकुलोद्वह। अन्तर्हितं माययाभूत ततोऽहं विस्मितोऽभवम्॥
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, I could not then see the Saubha, for it had then disappeared on account of the illusion (displayed by the Danava). I became astonished.

sa: ततः क्षिप्तमिवात्मानं द्रौपद्या स परंतपः। नामृष्यत महाबाहुः प्रहारमिव सद्भवः॥
en: Thereupon, the tormentor of his foes, Bhimasena of mighty arms, considering himself as conjured by Draupadi, looked like an wounded bull of excellent breed and could not brook (her remarks).

sa: पूर्णचन्द्रनिभां श्यामां चारुवृत्तपयोधराम्। वन्तीं प्रभया देवी सर्वा वितिमिरा दिशः॥
en: Also, the lady is like the full moon in splendour. She looks ever youthful, possessing a handsome breast; and dispelling darkness from all the directions by virtue of her effulgence.

sa: ऋषभं तीर्थमासाद्य कोसलायां नराधिप। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः॥ गोसहस्रफलं विन्द्यात् कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्।
en: O ruler of men, going to the Tirtha, called Rishabha in Kosala and fasting there for three nights, a man obtains the fruits of Vajapeya sacrifice. He obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine and saves his race.

sa: अन्तःपुरे तं तु निवेश्य राजा। विभाण्डकस्यात्मजमकेपुत्रम्। मापूर्यमाणं च जगज्जलेन॥
en: But the king kept the only son of Vibhandaka in the female apartments. Then he saw that rain was suddenly poured by heaven and the world was flooded with water.

sa: मन्नियुक्ता मनुष्येन्द्र सर्वे च गिरिवासिनः। रक्षिष्यन्ति महाबाहो सहितं द्विजसत्तमैः॥
en: And all the dwellers of the mountain, O the best of men and mighty-armed one, being appointed by me will protect you as well as these best of the Brahmanas.

sa: स विदित्वा तु नृपतिः कुम्भयोनिमुपागतम्। विषयान्ते सहामात्यः प्रत्यगृहणात् सुसत्कृतम्॥
en: Having learnt of the arrival of the pot-born Rishi on the frontier of his kingdom, the king went out with his ministers and received the holy man with all respects.

sa: क्रोशमात्रमपक्रान्तं गदापाणिमवस्थितम्। एकं दुर्योधनं राजन्नपश्यं भृशविक्षतम्॥
en: After I had come about two miles O king I beheld Duryodhana, standing alone, mace in hand and greatly wounded.

sa: न वोढारं धुरं तस्य कश्चिन्मेने प्रजापतिः॥ न भूतं न भविष्यं च सर्वराजसु संजय। अन्यत्रौशीनराच्छैब्याद् राजर्षेरिन्द्रविक्रमात्॥ अदक्षिणमयज्वानं मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः।
en: Brahma himself thought that no one amongst the kings of the past or the future had or could have borne the burden, O Srinjaya, the Ushinara's son Shibi, that best of kings and that most powerful hero, equal to that of Indra himself bore. Do not, therefore, grieve for your son who never celebrated any sacrifice nor made any present.

sa: पृथिवी देश इत्युक्तः कालः स च न दृश्यते। अभिप्रेतार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं ध्यायते यच्च तत्तथा॥
en: The divisions of the Earth are called place. Time is not seen. Regarding the success of any object or purpose, it is gained or not gained according to the manner in which the mind is engaged to think of it.

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वा या नार्यः पुरा देवगणैरपि। पृथग्जनेन दृश्यन्ते तास्तदा निहतेश्वराः॥
en: Those ladies who had not before this been seen by the very celestials were now helpless as they were in the absence of their lords, seen by the common people.

sa: उपायं धर्मबहुलं यात्रार्थं शृणु भारत। नाहमेतादृशं धर्मं बुभूषे धर्मकारणात्॥
en: Listen, O Bharata, to the highly meritorious expedient which kings should follow (during times of distress). For the sake of true morality, however, I would not call those means fair.

sa: अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो यत्र परमास्त्रेण वध्यते। समा द्वादश पर्जन्यस्तद्राष्ट्र नाभिवर्षति॥
en: The region where the weapon Brahmashira is counteracted by another high weapon, suffers from a drought for twelve years, for the clouds do not pour a drop of water you.

sa: दिष्ट्या स्नुषाणामाक्रन्दे घोरं विलपितं बहु। न शृणोषि महाराज सारसीनामिवार्णवे॥
en: By good luck, you do not hear those dreadful wails of woe uttered amidst this destruction by your daughter-in-law like the screams of a fight of cranes of the sea.

sa: तस्माद् विवर्धतां प्रीतिर्नित्यं संगतमस्तु कालातीतमिहार्थं तु न प्रशंसन्ति पण्डिताः॥
en: Therefore, let our love for each other increase, and let us be united. The wise never speak highly of the attempt of doing an act when its opportunity is gone.

sa: देवानामीश्वरं चक्रे देवं दशशतेक्षणम्। यमं वैवस्वतं चापि पितृणामकरोत् प्रभुम्॥
en: It was then that he made the divine Indra of a thousand eyes the king of gods. Yama the son of Vivasvat was made the lord of the departed manes.

sa: वृत्तं यस्य श्लाघनीयं मनुष्याः सन्तो विद्वांसोऽर्हयन्त्यर्हणीयम्। स्वर्गं जित्वा वीरलोकानवाप्य सिद्धिं प्राप्तः पुण्यकीर्तिर्महात्मा॥
en: His life was worthy of every complement. Learned and honest, men speak high of it, for it deserves every praise. Having acquired heaven and won the regions reserved for heroes, that great king of virtuous deeds became drowned with success.

sa: आविक्षितं मरुत्तं च मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम॥ यस्य सेन्द्राः सवरुणा बृहस्पतिपुरोगमाः। देवा विश्वसृजो राज्ञो यज्ञमीयुर्महात्मनः॥ यः स्पर्धयायजच्छकं देवराजं पुरंदरम्।
en: We hear, O Srinjaya, that there was a king of the name of Marutta who was the son of Avikshit. He also met with death. The gods with Indra and Varuna and Brihaspati at their head came to the sacrifice, called Vishvasrij, celebrated by that great king. Challenging Shakra the king of the gods, that king defeated him in battle.

sa: न हि तेषामहं दुग्धस्तत्तेषां दोषदर्शनम्। अरेर्हि दुहृदाद् भेयं भग्नपुच्छादिवोरगात्॥
en: I do not cherish any hostility towards them. I am engaged in only ascertaining their faults. As one should fear a wounded snake, cvery one should fear a wicked foe.

sa: अन्त्येषु पुत्रान् निक्षिप्य यदुद्रुह्युपुरोगमान्। पूरुं राज्येऽभिषिच्याथ सदारः प्राविशद् वनम्॥
en: At last discarding his other sons headed by Yadu and Druhyu, he installed (his youngest son) Puru on his throne and then returned to the forest accompanied by his wife.

sa: प्रहृष्टवित्रस्तविषण्णाविस्मितास्तथा परे शोकहता इवाभवन्। परे त्वदीयथैषां परस्परेण यथायथैषां प्रकृतिस्तथाभवन्॥
en: Amongst them, belonging to your army as well as to the enemy's some showed signs of joy, some of fear, some of sorrow, some of wonder and some of grief.

sa: अधनः कस्य किं वाच्यो विमुक्तः सर्वशः सुखी। देवस्वमुपगृव धनेन न सुखी भवेत्॥
en: One, however, that has no wealth, is never blamed. Forsaking all attachments, such a person can become happy in all respects by living upon what little he may get as alms. No one, however, can be happy by acquiring riches.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ज्ञातिशोकाभितप्तस्य प्राणानभ्युत्सिसृक्षतः । ज्येष्ठस्य पाण्डुपुत्रस्य व्यासः शोकमपानुदत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Vyasa then removed the grief of the cldest of Pandu, who, filled with sorrow consequent on the destruction of his kinsmen, had resolved to throw off his life-brcaths.

sa: वाङ्मात्रेण विनीतः स्याद्धृदयेन यथा क्षुरः। श्लक्ष्णपूर्वाभिभाषी च कामक्रोधौ विवर्जयेत्॥
en: In words only should the king show his humility, but at heart he should be sharp as a razol. He should renounce lust and anger, and speak sweetly and mildly.

sa: एवं दण्डं प्रशंसन्ति पण्डितास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः। तस्माच्चतुष्टये तस्मिन् प्रधानो दण्ड उच्यते॥
en: Men endued with learning and knowledge of truth speak high of Punishment. Hence, of the four-fold means, viz., Conciliation, Gift, Dissension and Punishment, Punishment is said to be the foremost.

sa: पितॄन् भ्रातृन् परित्यज्य वयस्यानपि चापरे। हतधुर्या रथाः केचिद्धतसूतास्तथा परे॥
en: Some deserted their father and brothers and others their comrades. Some car-warriors lost their animals. Others lost their drivers. Some had their poles or yokes of wheels broken, O king.

sa: अथापश्यं सात्यकि तमुपायान्तं महारथम्। रथैश्चतु:शतैर्वीरो मामभ्यद्रवदाहवे॥
en: I then beheld the great car-warrior Satyaki rushing against us. With four hundred cars that hero pursued me in battle.

sa: धर्मार्थो धर्मकामौ च कामार्थो चाप्यपीडयन्। धर्मार्थकामान् योऽभ्येति सोऽत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते॥
en: Whoever, without making distinction between Morality and Profit, or Morality and Pleasure, or Pleasure and Profit, follows all three, viz., Morality, Profit and Pleasure, always succeeds in obtaining great happiness.

sa: ते मोहवशमापन्ना मनुजा मनुजर्षभ। प्रतिपत्तिविमोहाच्च धर्मस्तेषामनीनशत्॥
en: Having become subject to error, the perceptions of men, O prince, became clouded, and thence their virtue began to wane.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच धर्मराज किमर्थं त्वमधर्ममनुमन्यसे। हतबन्धोर्यदेतस्य पतितस्य विचेतसः॥ दुर्योधनस्य भीमेन मृद्यमानं शिरः पदा। उपप्रेक्षसि कस्मात् त्वं धर्मज्ञः सन्नराधिप।॥
en: Vasudeva said O Yudhishthira why do you allow such a wrong act, since you suffer the head of the insensible and fallen Duryodhana whose relatives and friends have all been killed to be thus struck by Bhima with his foot? conversant as thou art with the rules of Ethics, why do you, O king, look at this act with indifference?'

sa: प्रद्विषन्ति परिख्यातं राजानमतिखादिनम्॥ प्रद्विष्टस्य कुतः श्रेयो नाप्रियो लभते फलम्।
en: The subjects hate that king who becomes notorious for greediness. How can a king who is hated acquire prosperity? Such a king can never secure what is for his well-being.

sa: श्रुतावतीति धर्मात्मा देवर्षिगणसंसदि। स्वे च तामाश्रमे न्यस्य जगाम हिमवद्वनम्॥
en: The name the pious Rishi gave her on the presence of the gods and Rishis was Shruvavati. Leaving the girl in his hermitage, Bharadvaja went to the forest of Himavat.

sa: संदर्शनेन पुरुषं जघन्यमपि चोदयेत्। आरम्भान् द्विषतां प्राज्ञः सर्वार्थाश्च प्रसूदयेत्॥
en: A king should even sent a low person to ascertain the disposition and doings of his enemies. A wise king should frustrate all the attempts and objects of his enemies.

sa: कार्यार्थं कृतसंधी तौ दृष्ट्वा मार्जारमूषिको। उलूकनकुलौ तूर्णं जग्मतुस्तौ स्वमालयम्॥
en: Indeed, seeing the cat and the mouse make that agreement for fulfilling their mutual object, the mongoose and the owl both left that spot and repaired to their respective quarters.

sa: चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य धर्माश्च रक्षितव्या महीक्षिता। धर्मसंकररक्षा च राज्ञां धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Kings should protect the four castes in the discharge of their duties. it is the eternal duty of kings not to allow the confusion of duties of the different orders.

sa: प्रव्याहर यदुश्रेष्ठ त्वमग्रे मधुसूदन। त्वं हि नस्तात सर्वेषां सर्वधर्मविदुत्तमः॥
en: O foremost one of Yadu's race, do you, therefore, O destroyer of Madhu, speak first. You are the foremost of us all and are conversant with every duty and practice.'

sa: देववंशान् पितृवंशान् ब्रह्मवंशांश्च शाश्वतान्। संत्यज्य मूढा वर्तन्ते ततो यान्त्यश्रुतीपथम्॥
en: And since those little-witted men live by abandoning the eternal paths of the gods, of the Rishis, and of Brahma, therefore, they attain to paths disapproved of by the Shrutis.

sa: दिष्ट्या नाहं परावृत्तो युद्धे कस्यांचिदापदि। दिष्ट्याहं निहतः पापैश्छलनैव विशेषतः॥
en: By good luck, I never turned back from battle, whatever misfortunes over-took me. By good luck, I have been killed by those sinful men, by the help of deceptive means.

sa: ततः कालपरीतः स वैरस्योद्धरणे रतः। प्रतीपकारी युष्माकमिति चोपेक्षितो मया॥
en: Yielding to the influence of Time, he was determined on creating enmity with you. As he was determined upon doing injuries to you all, I myself gave up the attempt.'

sa: हतशिष्टाश्च राजानो युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। धृतराष्ट्रश्च कृष्णश्च भीमार्जुनयमास्तथा॥
en: The residue of the king with Yudhishthira at their head, Dhritarashtra, Krishna, Bhima, Arjuna and the twins also came there.

sa: तस्मात् कौरव्य धर्मेण प्रजा: पालय नीतिमान्। एवंवृत्तः प्रजा रक्षन् स्वर्ग जेतासि दुर्जयम्॥
en: Therefore, O you of Kuru's race, protect your subjects righteously, with the help of that great science. By protecting your subjects and adopting such a conduct, you will, forsooth, attain to such blessedness in heaven which cannot be easily acquired.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यदा ते स्युः सुमनसो लोके धर्मार्थनिश्चये। कालप्रभवसंस्थासु सज्जन्ते च त्रयस्तदा॥
en: When men in this world try with pure hearts to gain Profit with the help of Virtue, then those three, viz., Virtue, Profit, and Pleasure, may be seen to exist in a state of union regarding time, cause, and action.

sa: अग्न्याधेयानि गुर्वर्थं क्रतूनपि सुदक्षिणान्। ददात्यहरहः पूर्वं को नु धर्मरतस्ततः॥
en: Who is there that is more virtuous then he who maintains his sacred fire, who celebrates sacrifices with presents of animals and money, and who administers charity day and night?

sa: ततस्तु तावकाः शूरा नानाशस्त्रसमायुताः॥ नानावादित्रशब्देन पाण्डुसेनामयोधयन्।
en: Then your warriors, armed with various weapons, fought with the Pandavas, causing the blowing and beating of various musical instruments.

sa: तदद्भुततमं लोके पप्रथे कुरुसत्तम। बुबुधे तच्च देवेन्द्रो वरदानं महर्षितः॥
en: This wonderful fact, O best of the Kurus, soon became widely known over the world. The king of the gods also learnt of it as the outcome of Paravata's boon.

sa: न भयं तस्य भूतेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यश्चैव भारत। नासतो विद्यते राजन् स शरण्येषु गोपतिः॥
en: Such a man will have no fear from any creature, O Bharata. He will have no fear from wicked men. If such a man goes to the forest, he will be able to live there as securely as a king.

sa: अर्थस्य रक्षणार्थाय परेषां धर्मकारणात्। परेषां सिद्धिमाकाङ्क्षन् नीचः स्याद् धर्मभिक्षुकः॥
en: One, who seeks for virtue, does not commit a sin by saying a falsehood, if it be said to save the wealth and prosperity of others, or for religious purposes.

sa: जटी द्विजिह्वस्ताम्रास्यो मृगराजतनुच्छदः। एतद् रूपं बिभर्युग्रं दण्डो नित्यं दुराधरः॥
en: He has matted locks and two tongues. His face has the colour of copper, and he is clad in a lion's skin. That irresistible god assumes such a dreadful form.

sa: दण्डेन सहिता ह्येषा लोकरक्षणकारिका। निग्रहानुग्रहरता लोकाननुचरिष्यति॥
en: Helped by punishment this science will protect the world. Meting out rewards and punishments, this science will work among men.

sa: एवं संशप्तशपथाः समभित्यक्तजीविताः। अमित्रवाहिनीं वीराः प्रतिगाहन्त्यभीरवः॥
en: Having taken such an oath, and prepared to cast away his itself, heroes should bravely rush against the enemy's ranks.

sa: तानन्ये रथमारोप्य ह्याश्वास्य च मुहूर्तकम्॥ विश्रान्ताश्च वितृष्णाश्च पुनर्युद्धाय जग्मिरे।
en: Others, taking them up on their own cars and soothing them for some time and resting them and satisfying their thirst by offering them drink, once more proceeded to battle.

sa: स बभौ राजमध्यस्थो नीलवासाः सितप्रभः॥ दिवीव नक्षत्रगणैः परिकीर्णो निशाकरः।
en: Clad in blue robes and possessed of a fair complexion, Rama, as he sat midst those kings shone like the Moon in the sky encircled by a number of stars.

sa: लीनः स तस्य गात्रेषु पलितो देशकालवित्। चिच्छेद पाशान् नृपते कालापेक्षी शनैः शनैः॥
en: Thereafter, the mouse Palita, who knew well the requirements of time and place, began, as he lay under the body of the cat, to cut the strings of the noose slowly, waiting for the proper time to finish his work.

sa: भीष्म उवाच विज्ञानबलमास्थाय जीवितव्यं तथागते। सर्वं साध्वर्थमेवेदमसाध्वर्थं न किंचन॥
en: Bhishma said When such a time appears the Brahmana should live by the help of knowledge. Everything in this world is for the good. Nothing here is for the wicked.

sa: नीलाङ्गा पिङ्गलाङ्गाश्च मुण्डवक्त्रास्तथैव च। भेरीशङ्खमृदङ्गांश्च झर्झरानकगोमुखान्॥
en: Those beings, called companions, having golden complexions, and filled with joy, played upon drums. horns, cymbals, Jharjharas, Anakas and Gomukhas.

sa: सर्वभूताश्रय विभो हविर्भूतमवस्थितम्। प्रतिगृहाण मां देव यद्यशक्याः परे मया॥
en: O lord, O thou that art the refuge of ail creatures, I wait as a libation for you, since I am unable to defeat my enemies. Accept me, O god.'

sa: ततोऽस्त्रसंघातसमाकुलं तदा बभूव जन्यं विततांशुजालम्। तत् निरन्तरं चक्रतुरम्बरं तदा॥
en: Karna and Partha now covered the whole sky with showers of arrows; not even a little space was left and it looked like a brilliant and thick net-work of shafts.

sa: तावुभौ तपसोपेताववनीतलचारिणौ। भुञ्जानौमानुषान् भोगान् यथावत् पर्यधावताम्॥
en: Both of them endued with great ascetic merit, they wandered over the Earth living on food taken by human beings.

sa: कुलीनत्वे च रमे दुष्कुलीनान् विकुत्सयन्। धनदर्पण दृप्तश्च दरिद्रान् परिकुत्सयन्॥
en: Proud of his high birth, one is seen to speak ill of those that are but high born. Elated with pride of wealth, one is seen to hate the poor.

sa: अकूजनेन चेन्मोक्षो नावकूजेत् कथंचन। अवश्यं कूजितव्ये वा शङ्करन् वाप्यकूजनात्॥ श्रेयस्तत्रानृतं वक्तुं सत्यादिति विचारितम्। यः पापैः सह सम्बन्धान्मुच्यते शपथादपि॥
en: If by becoming silent, one succeeds in escaping, one should remain silent, If, however, one's silence at a time when one must speak creates suspicion, it would be better then to say what is untrue than what is true. This is right conclusion. If one can escape from sinful men by an oath, one may take it without committing sin.

sa: यन्मित्रं भीतवत्साध्यं यन्मित्रं भयसंहितम्। सुरक्षितव्यं तत् कार्यं पाणिः सर्पमुखादिव॥
en: That friendship which is beset with fear and which cannot be maintained without fear, should be preserved with great caution like the hand (of the snake-charmer) from the snake's fangs!

sa: वानप्रस्थेषु विप्रेषु त्रैविद्येषु च भारत। प्रयच्छतोऽर्थान् विपुलान् वन्याश्रमपदं भवेत्॥
en: That king, who gives to persons leading a Vanaprastha mode of life and to Brahmanas versed in the three Vedas, attains to the object of the Vanaprastha mode of life.

sa: भरणं पुत्रदाराणां वेदानां धारणं तथा। वसतामाश्रमं श्रेष्ठं वदन्ति परमर्षयः॥
en: The great Rishis have said that the maintenance of sons and wives, and the study of the Vedas, are the duties of those who follow this high mode of life.

sa: जटामण्डलसंवीत: स्वर्णचीरो महातपाः॥ हेमदण्डधरो राजन् कमण्डलुधरस्तथा।
en: Wearing matted locks and shining like gold, he carried in his hands, O king, a golden stalf and a waterpot.

sa: अत्र गाथा यज्ञगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। वैखानसानां राजेन्द्र मुनीनां यशुमिच्छताम्॥
en: Regarding it, persons, conversant with ancient histories, cite a verse, O king, sung in praise of sacrifice by the Vaikhanasa Munis on the occasion of performing a sacrifice of theirs.

sa: उत्स्रष्टुकामः शस्त्राणि ऋषिवाक्यप्रचोदितः। तेजसा पूर्यमाणश्च युयुधे न यथा पुरा॥
en: He desired to lay his weapon aside urged to do so by the words of the sages. Though still charged with great energy, he was unable to fight as before.

sa: तत्रः क्रुद्धो वृषसेनो महात्मा ववर्ष ताविषुजालेन वीरः। महारथावेकरथे समेतौ शरैः प्रभिन्दन्निव पाण्डवेयौ॥
en: Then that noble-minded and brave warrior Vrishasena excited with rage, began to rain hosts of arrows upon those two powerful carwarriors seated on the same car with the purpose of distressing those two sons of Pandu at the same time.

sa: भावित्वाच महाराज वक्तुं समुपचक्रमे॥ तमतथ्यभये मग्नो जये सक्तो युधिष्ठिरः।
en: And owing to the inevitability of Fate, O king, Yudhishthira decided to say, what he was called upon to say. Afraid of speaking lies, but anxious to obtain victory, Yudhishthira.

sa: तद् भूतं सर्वभूतानामभावाय किलार्जुन। तपस्तप्तवा वरं प्राप्तं कृतमन्धं स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: That beast having, successfully performed all the austerities of asceticism with a view to kill all the animals, had received that boon but was made blind instead by the Self-born.

sa: पादतैराहता नागा विवरेषु समन्ततः। चक्रुरार्तस्वरं घोरं दुदुवुश्च दिशो दश॥
en: The elephants, struck from all sides in the different vital parts by the foot-soldiers, uttered very dreadful cries of pain and ran away towards the ten points of the compass.

sa: नागान् सप्तशतान् राजन्नीषादन्तान् प्रहारिणः। व्यधमत् सहसा भीमः क्रुद्धरूपः परंतपः॥
en: Suddenly the son ot Pandu, the consumer of enemies worked up with anger, dispersed seven hundred elephants with tusks as large as plough-shares and all skilled in smiting hostile soldiers.

sa: कौरवेयांस्ततः पार्थः सहसा समुपाद्रवत्॥ पञ्चालानेव तु द्रोणो धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमान्। ममर्दुस्तरसा वीराः पञ्चमेऽहनि भारत॥
en: Thereupon Pritha's son, all on a sudden attacked the Kaurava troops, while Drona too marched against the Panchala troops headed by Dhristadyumna. O Bharata, in that the fifth day of Drona's command, the brave combatants were slaughtered in quick succession.

sa: फलं चाशु प्रयच्छन्ति बोजमुप्तमृताविव। दोषमत्र न पश्यामि शूराणां रर्णमूर्धनि॥
en: And they yield an early harvest like sceds sown into the soil (at the proper time). I do not find any fault with the warriors on the field of battle.

sa: किमन्यद् दैवसंयोगान्मन्यसे पुरुषाधम॥ यांश्च तान् स्तौषि सततं दुर्योधनरिपून् द्विजा
en: To what do you, that are the basest of men, attribute all this except the hand of fate? O twice-born one, as to the enemies, Duryodhana whom you always extol.

sa: धर्मज्ञा युद्धकुशला हन्युर्युद्धे सुरानपि॥ एते स्थास्यन्ति संग्रामे पाण्डवानां वधार्थिनः।
en: Conversant with religion and well skilled in battle, would slay the very gods in battle. These will remain on the field of battle for the purpose of destroying the Pandavas.

sa: एतया निहनिष्यामि सव्यसाचिनमाहवे॥ हते तु पाण्डवे कृष्णो भ्रातरश्चास्य सोदराः।
en: By means of this dart I will slay Savyasachi in battle. When this son of Pandu will be slain, Krishna, as will as his uterine brothers (i.e., Yudhishthira and Bhima).

sa: तयोस्तु धनुषी चित्रे छित्त्वा शौरिर्महायशाः। अथ तौ सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्वारयामास संयुगे॥
en: Having severed the most beautiful bows of those two brothers, then the highly celebrated Shauri restrained the progress of them both in the battle with a shower of sharp arrows.

sa: निहते चेदिराजे तु तत् खण्डं पित्र्यमाविशत्। अमर्षवशमापन्नः पुत्रोऽस्य परमास्रवित्॥
en: When the Chedi ruler was thus slain, his son versed in the use of excellent weapons became excited with wrath and sought to achieve the task his after left undone.

sa: विधित्सुः कलहस्यान्तं जिघांसुः कर्णमक्षिणोत्। हत्वा तस्यानुगांस्तं च हन्तुकामो महाबलः॥
en: Desirous of reaching the end of all those hostilities, he began to rob Karna's strength, out of a desire for slaying him. Having slain many other Kauravas the mighty Bhima.

sa: तन्नामृष्यत कौन्तेयः कर्णस्य स्मितमाहवे। युध्यमानेषु वीरेषु पश्यत्सु च समन्ततः॥
en: But the son of Kunti did not brook that derisive smile of Radha's, son in the midst of many other brave warriors, who were looking ai that fight between them.

sa: सुपर्णं पतगश्रेष्ठ वैनतेयं तरस्विनम्। भोगीवाह्वयसे पाते कर्ण पार्थं धनंजयम्॥
en: As a snake, for its own destruction, encounters the best of birds Garuda, highly active and of beautiful feathers, so do you O Karna, challenge Dhananjaya the son of Pritha.

sa: निवृत्तैश्च पुनः पार्थर्भग्नं शत्रुबलं महत्। अश्वत्थाम्नश्च सङ्कल्पाद्धताः कर्णेन सृञ्जयाः॥
en: The vast hostile force was repeatedly broken by the son of Pritha, who retreated (from the field). The Srinjaya were slaughtered by Karna in carrying out the purposes of Ashvatthama.

sa: ते यूयं स्थाणुमीशानं जिष्णुमक्लिष्टकारिणम्। योद्धारं वृणुतादित्याः स तान् हन्तासुरेतरान्॥
en: Then you, O Adityas, select that heroic warrior Stana, also called Ishana, as well as Jishnu, who can hardly be afflicted in the battle. He will surely slaughter these Asuras.

sa: स मां निशम्याथ महातपस्वी संशप्तवान् रोषपरीतचेताः। सूतोपधावाप्तमिदं तवास्त्रं न कर्मकाले प्रतिभास्यति त्वाम्॥
en: Hearing this the great ascetic, worked up with anger, imprecated a curse on me, saying-"On account of the deception O charioteer, by which you have got this weapon it will never come to your mind at the time of necessity.

sa: पादे तु दक्षिणे राजन् गौतमः सत्यविक्रमः। त्रिगतैः सुमहेष्वासैर्दाक्षिणात्यैश्च संवृतः॥
en: O king, the son of Gautama, possessed of the unbaffled prowess, was stationed in right foot, encompassed by the most powerful bowmen, the Trigartas and the troops from the south.

sa: कल्पतां नागमुख्यानां रथानां च वरूथिनाम्। संनयतां नराणां च वाजिनां च विशाम्पते॥ क्रोशतां चैव योधानां त्वरितानां परस्परम्। बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो दिवस्पृक् सुमहांस्ततः॥
en: Thereupon, O lord of the world, there was a terrible uproar of the best of elephants and cars overlaid with beautiful coverlets, whilst they were being equipped and of the infantry crying out in joy, of the horses, whilst being harnessed and of the warriors, whilst moving to and fro, as as shouting to one another in mirth's. The uproar was so very great that it reached the very heavens.

sa: एष शल्यो रथोपस्थे रश्मिसंचारकोविदः। सूतपुत्ररथं कृष्ण वाहयन् बहु शोभते॥
en: O Krishna, Shalya, a thorough master in the art of driving, is looking surpassingly beautiful, as he drives the chariot of Suta's son, seated on high seat of the car.

sa: रागो योगस्तथा दाक्ष्यं नयश्चेत्यर्थसाधकाः॥ उपाया: पण्डितैः प्रोक्तास्ते तु दैवमुपाश्रिताः।
en: 'Zeal, perseverance, as also skillfulness and diplomacy, these have been declared by the learned me to be the principal expedients of accomplishing ends, which, again, are wholly dependent upon Destiny.'

sa: तेषां निशाम्येगितानि युद्धे प्राणाञ्जुहूषताम्। समुद्वीक्ष्य मुखं राज्ञो बालार्कसमवर्चसम्॥ आचार्यपुत्रो मेधावी वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यमाददे।
en: Having understood the gestures of those, who were ready to sacrifice their lives in the battle and having beheld the face of the king, that had the splendour of the newly rising Sun. The highly intellectual son of Acharya, who

sa: चक्राणि चापविद्धानि तोमरांश्च महारणे। नानाविधानि शस्त्राणि प्रगृह्य जयगृद्धिनः॥ जीवन्त इव दृश्यन्ते गततत्त्वासनस्विनः।
en: Look also at these discuses (cakras) and tomaras used in this great war. The warriors in sheer excitement for victory have lost their lives in course of attack with weapons still in their hands are appear as if still living.

sa: ततो वर्षसहस्रे तु समेष्याम:परस्परम्। एकीभावं गमिष्यन्ति पुराण्येतानि चानघ॥ समागतानि चैतानि यो हन्याद् भगवंस्तदा। एकेषुणाः देववरः स नो मृत्युभविष्यति॥
en: Then after one thousand years we will again unite together; and ( faultless one, these three cities, belonging to ourselves, will also attain the similar condition once more. Whenever, O lord, any one of the celestials will penetrate with a single arrow those cities united into the one that most excellent of celestials will become the cause of our death."

sa: केऽरक्षन् दक्षिणं चक्रमाचार्यस्य महाहवे। के चोत्तरमरक्षन्त निघ्नत: शात्रवान् बहून्॥
en: (And) when the preceptor was engaged in the terrible slaughter of the enemy in that great battle, who did protect the right wheel (of his car) and who the left?

sa: संजय उवाच अपराह्ने महाराज संग्रामः सुमहानभूत्। पर्जन्यसमनिर्घोषः पुनद्रोणस्य सोमकैः॥
en: Sanjaya said On the afternoon, O mighty monarch, a terrible battle was fought between Drona and the Somakas, battle whose din resembled the rumble of the rain cloud Parjannya itself.

sa: अतीव सर्वशब्देभ्यो लोमहर्षकरः प्रभो॥ अर्जुनस्य महाबाहो तावकानां च धन्विनाम्।
en: That sound surpassed all other sounds and O lord, made the hair stand erect. Thus, O mighty-armed one, the battle between Arjuna and your warriors went on (with unmitigated fury).

sa: भीमसेनं तदा क्रुद्धं भीमरूपो भयानकः। प्रत्यवारयदायान्तमार्घ्यशृङ्गिर्महारथः॥
en: That mighty car-warrior the son of Rishyashringa, of dreadful appearance and fierce temper, opposed the enraged Bhimasena rushing upon Drona.

sa: अवध्यत्वं च ते राजन् सर्वभूतस्य सर्वदा। सहिता वरयामासुः सर्वलोकपितामहम्॥
en: O monarch, they, have united with one another, asked of the great grandsire of all the worlds that boon, namely that they would not attain death from all creatures always.

sa: सम्पतन्तो व्यदृश्यन्त भ्राजमाना इवाग्नयः। दुर्योधनपुरोवातां रथनागबलाहकाम्॥
en: Looked like blazing sparks of fire when they fell. Duryodhana was the precursory wind, cars and elephants were the clouds,

sa: न चेत्तदभिमन्येत पुरुषोऽर्जुनदर्शिवान्। शतं दद्यां गवां तस्मै नैत्यकं कांस्यदोहनम्॥
en: If the person who will point out Arjuna be not contented with it, I shall give him a hundred kine with an equal number of brass vessels for milching them.

sa: निहते सैन्धवे वीरे भूरिश्रवसि चैव ह। : यदाभ्यगान्महातेजाः पञ्चालानपराजित॥
en: (You say that) on the slaughter of the heroic king of Sindhu as well as of Bhurisrava that unvanquished one (i.e., Drona) endued with great energy rushed against the Srinjayas.

sa: द्रौणिस्तदपि राजेन्द्र भल्लैः क्षिप्रं महारथः॥ चिच्छेद समरे वीरः क्षिप्रहस्तो दृढायुधः। रथादनवरूढस्य तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: O king, the great car-warrior, the heroic son of Drona, displaying light handedness and holding firm his weapon, quickly cut-off in battle with Bhallas, that weapon of his, before he could come down from the car. It was indeed wonderful.

sa: तव पुत्रः सदामर्षी कृतास्त्रो युद्धदुर्मदः। दुःशासनो महाराज भीमसेनेन पातितः॥
en: O great king, your ever wrathful son Dushasana, who is well acquainted with the science of weapons and who is incapable of being vanquished in battle, was slain by Bhimasena.

sa: संजय उवाच अनाद्दत्य तु तद् वाक्यं मद्रराजेन भाषितम्। याहीत्येवाब्रवीत् कर्णो मद्रराजं तरस्विनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Disregarding the words spoken by the king of Madra Karna said to him who was greatly active-"go on". Sanjaya said Disregarding the words spoken by the king of Madra Karna said to him who was greatly active-"go on".

sa: सुरेशत्वं गतः शक्रो हत्वा दैत्यान् सहस्रशः॥ त्वत्प्रसादाद्धषीकेश जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्।
en: That Shakra having destroyed thousands of Daityas acquired the kingship of the celestials, O Hrishikesha, it is by reason of your grace, the universe, with its mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा व्यथिताकारान् सैन्यानि तव भारत। ऊर्ध्वमेव निरैक्षन्त दुःखत्रस्यान्यनेकशः॥
en: descendant of the Bharata race, seeing them changed in countenance, on account of their being oppressed with sorrow, your troops, themselves being highly afflicted with grief and anxiety, looked upwards.

sa: विमां पातयामास गजस्कन्धाद्विशांपते। रुधिरेणावसिक्तांगो जलसन्धस्य कुञ्जरः॥
en: Brought down the wooden structure from the back of that elephant. O king, steeped in blood, that elephant of Jalasandha.

sa: विवस्त्रायुधदेहासून कृत्वा शत्रून् सहस्रशः॥ युक्त्वा स्वर्गयशोभ्यां च स्वेभ्यो मुदमुदावहत्।
en: Sundering the armour, weapons and bodies of thousands of his enemies, killing them by thousands and sending them to heaven to earn fame Karna gave great delight to his friends.

sa: तौ तु सैन्धवमालोक्य वर्तमानमिवान्तिके। सहसा पेततुः क्रुद्धौ क्षिप्रं श्येनाविवामिषम्॥
en: Beholding the ruler of the Sindhus stay near them and burning with rage, they pounced down upon him, like a pair of hawks pouncing down upon a piece of meat.

sa: सुवर्णपुङ्खा नाराचाः शत्रुघ्ना वैद्युतप्रभाः॥ त्वयास्तास्तस्य वर्माणि भित्वा पास्यन्ति शोणितम्।
en: Let the gold-feathered iron shafts, capable of dealing death to the enemies and emitting rays of lightning, sped by you go straight into the vital organs and drink his blood.

sa: तैर्ललाटार्पितैर्वाणैर्युयुधानस्त्वजिह्मगैः। व्यरोचत महाराज त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः॥
en: O mighty monarch, with those straightgoing shafts struck the forehead, Yuyudhana appeared beautiful like a mountain with three peaks. on

sa: विप्रदुते बले तस्मिन् वध्यमाने समन्ततः। द्रौणिरेकोऽभ्ययात् तूर्णं भीमसेनं महाबलम्॥
en: Amongst your whole force, that was immensely slain and (the rest) running away from the field, the son of Drona alone proceeded with great impetuosity against that highly powerful Bhimasena.

sa: तस्माच्छराः प्रादुरासञ्छतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। संछादयन्तः समरे द्रौणिमाहवशोभिनम्॥
en: Issuing out of it, hundreds and thousands of shafts covered, in that battle, that ornament of battle namely Drona's son.

sa: बलार्णवौ ततस्तौ तु समेयातां निशामुखे। वातोधूतौ क्षुब्धसत्त्वौ भैरवौ सागरविव॥
en: Then those two sea of troops encountering each other at the dead of night resembled two dreadful sees agitated by the tempest with all the creatures within them dreadfully terrified.

sa: अलातचक्रप्रतिमं तस्य मण्डलमायुधम्। द्रौणेरासीन्महाराज बाणान् विसृजतस्तदा॥
en: Then as he shot those shafts, O mighty monarch, the bow of Drona's son looked like a circle of fire.

sa: प्रमुञ्चन्तं बाणसंघानमेयान् मर्मच्छिदो वीरहणः सुपत्रान्॥ कुन्तीपुत्रं यत्र योतस्यामि युद्धे ज्यां कर्षतामुत्तममद्य लोके।
en: I will today, in this world, withstand in fight the son of Kunti the foremost of archers while he will ceaselessly discharge his winged arrows capable of killing heroes and penetrating into every limb and none of which becomes futile.

sa: पश्य वृष्ण्यन्धकव्याघ्रं सौमदत्तिवशं गतम्। तव शिष्यं महाबाहो धनुष्यनवरं त्वया॥
en: Behold O mighty-armed one, that foremost hero among the Vrishnis and Andhakas, that disciple of yours who is not inferior to you in bowmanship, succumb to the son of Somadatta.

sa: तं विजित्याथ कर्णोऽपि पञ्चालांस्त्वरितो ययौ। रथेनातिपताकेन चन्द्रवर्णहयेन त ॥
en: Then Karna, after having defeated him (Nakula), rushed most rapidly against the Panchalas, riding upon a car, that was furnished with innumerable standards and having the colour of the moon.

sa: स बाध्यमानः समरे द्रौणिना युद्धदुर्मदः॥ द्रौणिं पाञ्चालतनयो वाग्भिरार्जयत् तदा।
en: Thus covered (with arrows) in that battle by the son of Drona, the son of the Panchala king, invincible in battle, thundered forth these words to the son of Drona.

sa: प्रतिविन्ध्यस्ततो राजस्तोमरं हेमभूषितम्। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धश्चित्रस्य वधकाङ्क्षया।॥
en: Thereupon, O monarch, the most wrathful Prativindhya, most desirous of slaying Chitra, hurled at him a lance adorned with gold.

sa: ततो भीमः शरशतैर्दुर्योधनममर्षणम्। विमुखीकृत्य तरसा गजानीकमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Thereupon making the angry Duryodhana retreat from the battle-field with a hundred arrows Bhima quickly advanced against the elephant force.

sa: ततः शरसहस्रेण सुप्रयुक्तेन पाण्डवः। द्रोणपुत्रमवच्छाद्य सिंहनादममुञ्चत॥
en: Thereupon the Pandava, after having covered the son of Drona with one thousand arrows, well-aimed, sent forth a leonine roar.

sa: यदपकृष्टः स रथान्नयासितश्चायुधं भुवि। ततो नारायणास्रं तत् प्रशान्तं शत्रुतापनम्॥
en: When he was thus dragged down from the car, when he was thus compelled to lay his weapons aside, the Narayana weapon, capable of burning down the foe, became pacified.

sa: महाभुजगसंकाशौ चन्दनागुरुरूषितौ॥ अपश्यं भीमसेनस्य धनुर्विक्षिपतो भुजौ।
en: There they saw the two arms of Bhimasena, holding bows, pasted with sandal and Aguru and resembling two huge serpents.

sa: निर्विद्धस्तु शरैोरैरक्रुद्ध्यत् सात्यकि शम्। सायकान् व्यसृजचापि वीरो रुक्मरथं प्रति॥
en: Pierced deeply with those fierce arrows Satyaki became exited to the highest pitch of Wrath; and then that hero began to shoot numerous arrows at him of the golden car.

sa: उलूकस्तु ततः क्रुद्धस्तव पुत्रस्य संयुगे। क्षुरप्रेण धनुश्छित्त्वा ताडयामास कर्णिना॥
en: Thus Uluka, too, being highly enraged and cutting off the bow of your son with a razor like shaft, struck him with a barbed arrows in the field of battle.

sa: अभिद्रवन्तु वेगेन कुम्भयोनिवधेप्सया। तथैव रथिनः सर्वे हस्त्यश्वं यच किञ्चन॥
en: Let, the inspired with the desire for achieving the slaughter of Bharadvaja's son, assail him from all sides. So also, let all the other car-warriors and clephant riders and horsemen.

sa: न्यस्तशस्रमधर्मेण घातयित्वा गुरुं भवान्॥ रक्षत्विदानीं सामात्यो यदि शक्तोऽसि पार्षतम्।
en: Having slain by a deceitful means your preceptor who had laid his weapons aside, now your counsellors, protect the son of Prishata, if indeed, you arc equal to the task.

sa: तामापतन्तीं सहसा महोल्काप्रतिमां तदा। द्विधा चिच्छेद समरे प्रतिविन्ध्यो हसन्निव॥
en: Prativindhya, as if laughing, severed into two pieces that shaft, in the field of battle, falling upon him, which was like a great flashing meteor suddenly falling from the sky.

sa: अस्माकं च महाराज परेभ्यो बहवो जनाः। योद्धव्यमिति तिष्ठन्तो निद्रासंरक्तलोचनाः॥
en: Many again of your army, thinking that they should continue to fight with the foe, stood, O king, on the field of battle although their eyes were heavy with sleep.

sa: छिन्नमाज्ञाय निस्त्रिंशमवप्लुत्य पदानि षट्। प्राविध्यत ततः शेषं सुतसोमो महारथः॥
en: Knowing that his sword was thus severed, then that powerful car-warrior, Sutasoma, after having retreated six steps back, struck his antagonist with that half (he still held in his hand).

sa: महीधरसमः स्थैर्ये तेजसाग्निसमो युवा। समुद्र इव गाम्भीर्ये क्रोधे चाशीविषोपमः॥
en: Youthful in years, he resembles a mountain in endurance and fire in cnergy. In gravity he is equal to the ocean and in anger to a snake of virulent poison.

sa: किंकिणीशतसंहादो भ्राजंचित्रो रथोत्तमे। व्यभ्राजत भृशं राजन् पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते॥ ध्वजेन महता संख्ये कुरूणामृषभस्त
en: O king, that standard stood on the chariot of that hero, tinkling with the sound of a hundred bells. Then O monarch, in that battle with that huge standard, that foremost of the Kurus viz., your son appeared highly beautiful.

sa: बलं तेऽभज्यत विभो युयुधानशरार्दितम्। नाशयित्वा रणे सैन्यं त्वदीयं माधवोत्तमः॥
en: Beholding this, O master, your troops already afflicted with the shafts of Yuyudhana, broke and fled. Then that best of the descendants of Madhu's race, slaughtering in battle your warriors.

sa: ततोऽस्य केशान् सव्येन गृहीत्वा पाणिना तदा। पार्षतः क्रोशमानानां वीराणामच्छिनच्छिरः॥
en: The son of Prisata lopped off his head disregarding the expostulating cries of the heroes. From all sides they then said-"He should not be slain, He should not be slain.

sa: कृतवर्मा तु संक्रुद्धो मार्गणैः क्षतविक्षतः॥ ववाम रुधिरं गात्रैः कुम्भवक्त्रादिवोदकम्।
en: Kritavarman, too, who became very angry and who also was greatly wounded by those arrows, vomited blood from his various limbs, as a water-vessel sends forth water through its mouth.

sa: ततः प्रभूति भद्रं ते गवां द्वैधीकृताः खुराः। हयानां च स्तना राजंस्तदाप्रभृति नाभवन्॥ पीडितानां बलवता रुद्रेणाद्भुतकर्मणा।
en: May you be blessed; from that time forward the hoofs of all animals belonging to the bevine species came to be cloven (into two parts). O monarch, froin that time also the teats of horses, that were highly oppressed by that most powered Rudra. performing miraculous deeds, ceased to appear.

sa: चिरकालेप्सितं लोके युद्धमद्यास्तु कौरव। त्वरते मे मतिस्तात तप युद्धाभिकाङ्क्षिणी॥
en: O Kaurava, let the encounter which you looked so eargrly for, today take place; O sire, my heart that longs for the combat with you, cannot tolerate any more delay.

sa: तदानुतेपे सुरराजपुत्रो विनिःश्वसंश्चासिमथोद्वबह। तमाह कृष्णः किमिदं पुनर्भवान् विकोशमाकाशनिभं करोत्यसिम्॥
en: Then that son of Indra became repentant and sighing heavily unsheathed his sword. Seeing this, Krishna said-"Wait is this? Why do you draw your sword lustrous like the blue skies?

sa: घोरं युद्धमदीनेन मया हृद्याच्युतार्जुनौ। कृतं तेनान्तकेनेव प्रजाः सर्वा जिघांसता॥
en: O Achyuta, O Arjuna, a great encounter took place today between myself setting forth my best energies and that hero who appeared like Death incarnate bent upon destroying all creatures.

sa: एकीभावं गते चैव त्रिपुरत्वमुपागते॥ बभूव तुमुलो हर्षो देवतानां महात्मनाम्।
en: Thus then the three cities had come to be of similar character after having lost their individual features, there had taken place loud shouts of joy amongst the high-souled celestials.

sa: उदीर्णाश्च परान् दृष्ट्वा कम्पमानाः पुनः पुनः। अश्रुपूर्णक्षणास्रस्ता दीनास्त्वासन् विशाम्पते॥
en: Beholding their enemies then elated with joy and success, they repeatedly trembled in fear. O ruler of men, they were panic-stricken and depressed and their eyes were filled with tears.

sa: तच्छिरो न्यपतद् भूमौ चित्रसेनस्य दीप्तिमत्। यद्दच्छया यथा चन्द्रश्चयुतः स्वर्गान्महीतलम्॥
en: That head of Chitrasena, which looked most resplendent, fell down upon the earth, even as the moon, out of her own will, falls upon the ground, being loosened from heaven.

sa: संजय उवाच ते तथैव महाराज दंशिता रणमूर्धनि। संध्यागतं सहस्रांशुमादित्यमुपतस्थिरे॥
en: Sanjaya said The warriors then, O monarch, clad as they were in coats of mail, worshipped the sun of thousand rays as he made its appearance on the morning sky.

sa: यौधेयान् मालवान् राजन् मद्रकाणां गणान् युधि। प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय शूरान् बाणैर्युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: (And), O king, in a moment he sent to the region of Yama, with a number of darts, the heroic Youdheyas, the Malavas and hosts of the Madrakas in battle.

sa: श्रुतकर्मा ततो राजशत्रुणा समभिद्रुतः। शत्रुसंवारणं क्रुद्धो द्विधा चिच्छेद कार्मुकम्॥
en: At that time, O monarch, Shrutakarman, having been attacked by his antagonist (Chitrasena), became very wrathful and severed his bow, that was capable of resisting the enemies, into two pieces.

sa: प्रतिविव्याध तं तूर्णं तव पुत्रो महीपतिः॥ पञ्चभिर्निशितैबाणैः स्वर्णपुकैः शिलाशित।
en: Your son, that ruler of earth, most quickly pierced him (Yudhishthira) in return with five keen arrows, that were equipt with the wings of gold and sharpened on a stone.

sa: अस्मत्परोक्षं कर्माणि कृतानि प्रवहन्ति ते। स्वामिसत्कारयुक्तानि यानि तानीह दर्शय॥
en: Men speak of many feats achieved by you out of our view. Show all those feats to me that have rendered you worthy of the applause and reverence of others."

sa: अस्मत्परोक्षं कर्माणि कृतानि प्रवहन्ति ते। स्वामिसत्कारयुक्तानि यानि तानीह दर्शय॥
en: Men speak of many feats achieved by you out of our view. Show all those feats to me that have rendered you worthy of the applause and reverence of others."

sa: ततोऽविध्यद् ध्रुवोर्मध्ये नाराचेनार्जुनो भृशम्। स तेन विबभौ द्रौणिरूलरश्मिर्यथा रविः॥
en: Thereupon Arjuna deeply penetrated him (Ashvatthaman) in the midst of his eye-brows with a sharp arrow. Therewith the son of Drona blazed forth like the sun with his upward rays.

sa: जानती चाप्यकर्तव्यं कन्याया गर्भधारणम्। पुत्रस्नेहेन सा राजन् करुणं पर्यदेवयत्॥
en: O king of kings, though she knew that it was not proper for a maiden to be big with child, yet from her affection towards the child she wept bitterly.

sa: घण्णामात्मनि नित्यानामैश्वर्यं योऽधिगच्छति। न स पापैः कुतोऽनथैर्युज्यते विजितेन्द्रियः॥ षडिमे षट्सु जीवन्ति सप्तमो नोपलभ्यते। चौराः प्रमत्ते जीवन्ति व्याधितेषु चिकित्सकाः॥
en: These six always cease to care those who have previously done them good viz., a learned pupil, the tutor, he who has got a wife the mother, one whose desire has been satisfied, the woman, one whose wants have been removed, the giver, one who has crossed a river, boat and the diseased (who has been cured) and the physician.

sa: तदैव ते हि विक्रान्तुमीषुः कौरवनन्दनाः। धर्मपाशनिबद्धास्तु न चेलुः क्षत्रियव्रतात्॥
en: (If so) the descendants of Kuru would have liked to show their prowess at that time; virtuous as they are, they did not deviate from the duties of the Kshatriyas.

sa: त्वां हि माधवमाश्रित्य निर्भया मोघदर्पितम्। धार्तराष्ट्र सहामात्यं स्वयं समनुयुक्ष्महे॥
en: Depending on you, Madhava, we have without fear asked back our share (of the kingdom) from the son of Dhritarashtra and all his followers, who are filled with vain pride.

sa: प्रयाह्येतद् रथानीकं मद्बाहुबलरक्षितः। अप्रधृष्यतमं घोरं गुप्तं वीरैमहारथैः॥ मा भैस्त्वं राजपुत्राय क्षत्रियोऽसि परंतप।
en: Protected by the strength of my arms do you enter into the dreadful and inaccessible collection of arms guarded by brave and powerful horses. Fear not, O repressor of foes, for you are the foremost of princes and a Kshatriya.

sa: कृतज्ञं धार्मिकं सत्यमक्षुद्रं दृढभक्तिकम्। जितेन्द्रियं स्थितं स्थित्यां मित्रमत्यागि चेष्यते॥
en: Wise men should never contract friendship, nor with them who have fallen from the path of virtue. The man who is grateful, virtuous, the reverse of mean, has firm devotion.

sa: सोऽहं प्रतिग्रहीष्यामि ददात्वेतां भवान् मम। कुमारी देवग भामेकपुत्रभवाय मे॥
en: Therefore shall I accept (the maiden); you please give her to me so that a son may be born to me in the womb of her who bears god-like children."

sa: न कि वैक्लव्यसंसृष्ट आनृशंस्ये व्यवस्थितः। प्रजापालनसम्भूतं फलं किंचन लब्धवान्॥
en: He, that is affected by weakness of mind or heart and follows the Path of compassion, does not gain any portion of the fruits due to the protection of subjects.

sa: नारदः सर्वभूतानामन्तभूमिनिवासिनाम्। जानंश्चकार व्याख्यानं यन्तुः सर्वमशेषतः॥
en: Narada, who knew everything about all the creatures living in the nether regions, described them in detail to his companion.

sa: नैकरत्नविचित्रं तु काञ्चनं महदासनम्। विविधास्तरणाकीर्णं यत्रासातामरिंदमौ॥
en: The two subduer of enemies were seated there on a spacious seat of gold covered with many sorts of carpets.

sa: तत एनं महावेगैरर्दयामास तोमरैः। तानागतान् स चिच्छेद सौमित्रिर्निशतैः शरैः॥
en: Then he (Indrajita) began to hurl violently at Lakshmana, many javelins. But the son of Sumitra severed them to pieces as they were coming up to him, with sharpened arrows.

sa: निदेशस्थाविमौ यस्य मानसस्तस्य सेत्स्यते। संकल्पो धर्मराजस्य निश्चयो मे तदाभवत्॥
en: The wishes of him who had under his command these two, the desires of the king of virtue were bound to bear fruit such was my belief at the time.

sa: रुदती पुत्रशोकार्ता निशीथे कमलेक्षणा। धात्र्या सह पृथा राजन् पुत्रदर्शनलालसा॥
en: And, O monarch, accompanied by her nurse the lotus-eyed Pritha desirous of beholding her son again and again and overpowered with grief for her son and weeping piteously, at night.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततोऽविदूरे नलिनी प्रभूतकमलोत्पलाम्। सीताहरणदुःखार्तः पम्पां रामः समासदत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Then, Rama, distracted with grief at the abduction of Sita, got to the Lake Pampa situated at a short distance and full of several kinds of lotuses.

sa: अस्थिसंचयमारूढो भुञ्जानो मधुपायसम्। लक्ष्मणश्च मया दृष्टो दिधक्षुः सर्वतो दिशम्॥
en: I have (in my dream) beheld Lakshmana burning all the points (with his arrows) and eating rice mixed with honey and boiled with milk mounted on a heap of bones.

sa: शूरच वीरश्च विक्रान्तश्च नरर्षभ। भयार्तानां परित्राता संयुगेषु न संशयः॥
en: O you bull among men, you are just such a hero, brave and powerful. There is no doubt that in battle you are the rescuer of those struck with fear.

sa: नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः। शुक्लकेयूरकण्ठत्राः शुक्लमाल्याम्बरावृताः॥
en: Nakula and Sahadeva and the great carwarrior Satyaki, decked with white ornaments and putting on white garlands and white garments,

sa: अश्रान्तः स्यादनादाता सम्मतो निरुपद्रवः। शिष्टो न शिष्टवत् स स्याद् ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवित् कविः।।
en: He who never exerts himself, never accepts gifts from others, who is respected quiet, who though well versed (in the holy books) does not seem to be well versed, is a Brahmana-a wise man knowing Brahman or the Supreme soul.

sa: अकालज्ञासि सैरन्ध्र शैलूषीव विरोदिषि। विघ्नं करोषि मत्स्यानां दीव्यतां राजसंसदि॥
en: O Sairandhri, you are ignorant of opportunity and therefore weep like an actress; you are causing annoyance in the court of the Matsya's while they are diverting themselves with gaming.

sa: सुखप्रिये सेवमानोऽतिवेलं योगाभ्यासे यो न करोति कर्म। वित्तक्षये हीनसुखोऽतिवेलं दुःखं शेते कामवेगप्रणुन्नः॥
en: He, who having having devoted himself excessively to pleasures, does not to any deed leading to religious meditation, becomes extremely devoid of happiness after his wealth is gone and remains liable to be led by the force of his desires.

sa: कर्मणाऽऽचरितं पूर्वं सद्भिराचरितं च यत्। तदेवास्थाय मोदन्ते दान्ताः शमपरायणाः॥
en: Those who have self-control are of peaceful habits and rejoice, regulating their life by the example of deeds done in olden times and deeds in the present by the honest.

sa: आत्मानमेव प्रथमं द्वेष्यरूपेण यो जयेत्। ततोऽमात्यानमित्रांश्च न मोघं विजिगीषते॥
en: He, therefore, who brings himself first under control thinking that his senses are his prime enemies, in the end subjugates as a matter of certainty, his advisers and his enemies.

sa: देशाचारान् समयाञ्जातिधर्मान् बुभूषते यः स परावरज्ञः। स यत्र तत्राभिगतः सदैव महाजनस्याधिपत्यं करोति॥
en: He, who desires knowledge of the manners and customs of different countries and of the different languages and of the duties of the different casts, knows everything, high and low; wherever he goes, he attains to lordship over great men.

sa: यत्रतत्रशयो नित्यं येन केनचिदाशितः। पेन केनचिदाच्छन्नः स गोव्रत इहोच्यते॥
en: He, who ever sleeps at any place he likes, who lives on with what others place before him, is safe to be attached to the Go vows in this world.

sa: अतः किल महानग्निरन्तकाले समुत्थितः। धक्ष्यते मातले सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥
en: From this, at the time of the dissolution of the universe, springs up a fire, which consumes, O Matali, the three entire worlds with all their mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: शृङ्गारवेषाभरणौ रूपवन्तौ यशस्विनौ। महारथसहस्राणां समर्थो भरतर्षभौ॥
en: Adorned with beautiful ornaments and robes, and illustrious, these two foremost of Bharatas are capable of withstanding a thousand car-warrior.

sa: निमित्तं तत्र शकुनिरहं दुःशासनस्तथा। दुर्योधनश्च नृपतिधृतराष्ट्रसुतोऽभवत्॥
en: The cause of this are Shakuni, myself and Dushasana and also Duryodhana the son of Dhritarashtra, the ruler of men,

sa: सत्यप्रतिज्ञ यन्मे त्वं काममेकं निसृष्टवान्। उपाकुरुष्व तद् राजस्तस्मान्मुच्यस्व संकटात्॥
en: "O king, you are (always) firm in your promise. Formerly you promised me a boon. Do you grant it now and thereby save yourself the sin of an unredeemed promise."

sa: तांस्त्वं पदे प्रतिष्ठाप्य लोके विगतकल्मषः। भविष्यसि नरश्रेष्ठ पूजनीयो मनीषिणाम्॥
en: You having reinstated them in their position, will be freed from all your sins in this world and, O chief among men, you will be worshipped by all intelligent men.

sa: न राज्यं प्राप्तमित्येव वर्तितव्यमसाम्प्रतम्। श्रियं ह्यविनयो हन्ति जरा रूपमिवोत्तम्॥
en: One (a king) should not live a haughty life considering that he was already obtained a kingdom, for haughtiness destroys kingly prosperity, as old age (destroys) good appearance. measures as

sa: प्रभावं पौरुषं बुद्धिं जिज्ञासन्त्या मया तव। विदधत्या समाश्वासमुक्तं तेजोविवृद्धये॥
en: Desiring to know your might, manliness and intelligence, has all this been said by me as also for supporting your failing courage, sustaining your hope and for enhancing your energy.

sa: तयोर्भुजविनिष्पेषादुभयोर्बलिनोस्तदा। शब्दः समभवद् घोरो वेणुस्फोटसमो युधि॥
en: Those two powerful (heroes) thus fighting, the crush of their arms engendered a sound resembling the clatter of splitting bamboo's.

sa: सर्वलोकमिमं हन्युर्धर्मपाशसितास्तु ये। तेषां मां मानिनीं भार्यां सूतपुत्रः पदावधीत्॥
en: The son of a Suta has kicked me the honored wife of those who, if they had not been tied down by duty, could destroy the whole of this world.

sa: असकृत् तेन चोक्तेन किंचिदागतमन्युना। अयमुक्तः प्रयच्छेति जानता विभवं लघु॥
en: Knowing that his means were small he did not ask for anything but being addressed again and again, was thus commanded: You who have said this, make me this present.

sa: शमं तत्र लभेयं चेद् युष्मदर्थमाहापयन्। पुण्यं सुमहद् राजंश्चरितं स्यान्महाफलम्॥
en: If I succeed in ensuring peace there without a sacrifice of our interests, then will an act of great virtue and of large fruits be done by me, O king.

sa: संरम्भमाणो विजितः प्रसा तत्रापराधः शकुनेर्न कश्चित्। तस्मात् प्रणम्यैव वचो ब्रवीतु वैचित्रवीर्यं बहुसामयुक्तम्॥
en: Having once commenced, he lost through anger and no blame can for this attach to the son of Shakuni; therefore it behooves him (the messenger) to speak with due deference to the son of Vichitravirya and assume a conciliatory tone.

sa: ततः सात्यकिमारोप्य प्रययौ पुरुषोत्तमः। पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च रथघोषेण नादयन्॥
en: Then having caused Satyaki to mount on it, that best of male beings set out filling the earth and the sky with the rattle of the wheels of the chariot.

sa: तथा तमनुधावन्तं मृगयुं शकुनार्थिनम्। आश्रमस्थो मुनिः कश्चिद् ददर्शाथ कृताह्निकः॥
en: A certain Rishi living in a hermitage, who had finished his daily worship I saw that fowler following the birds, still in the hope of getting hold of the birds.

sa: नाकार्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि ब्राह्मणः सन् विशेषतः। श्रुतधर्मा सत्यशीलो जानन् धर्मानुशासनम्॥
en: I do not wish to do a wrong thing, especially as I am a Brahmanas, who have heard what virtue is and know the rules of virtue and am truthful.

sa: दुर्योधनश्च दुष्टात्मा कर्णश्च सहसौबलः। न च शत्रुरवज्ञेयो दुर्बलोऽपि बलीयसा॥
en: For Duryodhana is wicked-souled and so are Karna and the son of Subala. Even by a strong man an enemy should not be made light of though be he weak.

sa: इत्युक्ता तेन वैदेही परिवृत्य शुभानना। तृणमन्तरतः कृत्वा तमुवाच निशाचरम्॥
en: Thus spoken to, the princes of Videha endued with a beautiful face, turning away (from Ravana) and considering him as something more insignificant than a straw thus replied to him.

sa: पाण्ड्यश्च राजा समितीन्द्रकल्पो योधप्रवीरैर्बहुभिः समेतः। समागतः पाण्डवार्थं महात्मा लोकप्रवीरोऽप्रतिवीर्यतेजाः॥
en: And king Pandya too, in battle an equal of Indra, who is noble-minded, a hero energy, accompanied by many heroes, has come, espousing the cause of the sons of Pandu.

sa: अतिक्रामति यः शास्त्रं पितुर्धर्मार्थदर्शिनः। एते नश्यन्ति कुरवो दुर्योधनकृतेन वै॥
en: He does not obey the commands of his father who follows the path of virtue and worldly benefit. Duryodhana will bring on the destruction of the Kurus by his acts.

sa: सूतो हि मामधिरथो दृष्ट्वैवाभ्यानयद् गृहान्। राधायाश्चैव मां प्रादात् सौहार्दान्मधुसूदन॥
en: As soon as Adhiratha saw me who was just born, he took me to his house and out of affection for me presented me to Radha, O slayer of Madhu.

sa: कृतस्य करणाद् राजा स्वर्गमत्यन्तमश्नुते। त्रेतायाः करणाद् राजा स्वर्ग नात्यन्तमश्नुते॥
en: Owing to causing the Krita Yuga to prevail, a king enjoys exceedingly the fruits of heaven and owing to causing the Treta Yuga he enjoys moderately the fruits of heaven.

sa: अन्ततो दयितं नन्ति केचिदप्यपरे जनाः। तस्याङ्ग बलहीनस्य पुत्रान् भ्रातृनपश्यतः॥
en: At least the men on the other side kill some one who is dear; and a man, thus rendered weak, O adorable one and not seeing his sons and brothers.

sa: द्वैधीभूतेषु लोकेषु विनश्यत्सु च भारत। अब्रवीत् सृष्टिमान् देवो भगवाँल्लोकभावनः॥
en: When the world was divided into two parties and was about to be ruined, O Bharata-that god endued with divine prosperity, the creator and the protector of the world said

sa: स दृष्ट्वा विमले व्योम्नि निर्मलं शशलक्षणम्। ग्रहनक्षत्रताराभिरनुयातममित्रहा॥ कुमुदोत्पलपद्मानां गन्धमादाय वायुना। महीधरस्थः शीतेन सहसा प्रतिबोधित: ॥
en: From that mountain beholding on the clear cloudless heavens, the resplendent moon surrounded by planets, stars and constellations and (fanned) by a cool breeze laden with the fragrance of lilies, lotuses and other flowers of the same kind, that destroyer of foes was suddenly awakened (to a recollection of Sita).

sa: यः कलिङ्गान् समापेदे पाञ्चाल्यो युद्धदुर्मदः। शिखण्डिना वः कुरवः कृतास्त्रेणाभ्ययुञ्जत॥
en: Who fought with the Kalingas, that prince of Panchala; hard to vanquish in battle with that Shikhandin skillful in the use of weapons will they fight with you, the Kurus.

sa: सामात्यदारो ह्रियते गन्धर्वैर्दिवमाश्रितैः। तं मोक्षयत भद्रं वः सहदारं नराधिपम्॥
en: And also with his counsellors and wives. He is being carried away a prisoner by the Gandharvas who are in the sky. Be blessed. Rescue the king with his wives.

sa: निषसादासने राजा सहपुत्रो विशाम्पते। विदुरो मणिपीठे तु शुक्लस्पर्ध्या जिनोत्तरे॥
en: With his son sat on one seat, О lord of the world. The great Vidura sat on a holy seat covered with a white deer skin and decked with gems.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा राक्षसपति: कुम्भकर्णं तरस्विनम्। संदिदेशेतिकर्तव्यं वलावेगप्रमाथिनौ॥
en: Thus addressing the mighty Kumbhakarna, the lord of the Rakshasas pointed out to Vajravega and Pramathin what they should do.

sa: तैश्चेद् योद्धं मन्यते धार्तराष्ट्रो निर्वृत्तोऽर्थः सकलः पाण्डवानाम्। रुपैहि युद्धं यदि मन्यसे त्वम्॥
en: If war with them is thought of by the son of Dhritarashtra, then are all the subjects of the Pandavas gained. Therefore do not propose peace for gaining the end of the Pandavas; let there be war if you please.

sa: दूयामि भरतश्रेष्ठ दृष्ट्वा ते भ्रातरं प्रियम्। गोषु गोवृषसंकाशं मत्स्येनाभिनिवेशितम्॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata's beholding the beloved brother of yours, the foremost of men, appointed by the king of the Matsyas in looking after his kine, I feel grieved.

sa: पादाङ्गुष्ठेन चिक्षेप सुखं गरुडोरसि। ततःप्रभृति राजेन्द्र सह सर्पण वर्तते।॥
en: With the toe of his feet he threw Sumukha on the breast of Garuda and from that time forward O chief of kings, Garuda live (in friendship) with that serpent.
